course.name: Trade Momentum
course.tagline: Live momentum day-trading streams and mentorship for US equities, built around the first hour of the market open.
course.about: Trade Momentum is a day-trading education and live-streaming community founded by Kev in 2019, focused on rule-based momentum trading in US equities. The core membership includes live trading streams, real-time alerts and nightly watchlists; a separate 60-Day Trading Bootcamp offers a more structured, mentorship-led path for traders who want a full curriculum rather than ongoing alerts.

formats.label: Live trading streams
formats.description: Weekday streams, 9–11am EST, with full screen-share transparency during trades.

formats.label: Real-time alerts
formats.description: Buy/sell signals with entries, exits and stops.

formats.label: Nightly watchlists
formats.description: 3–5 hand-picked tickers shared premarket or the night before.

formats.label: Community & support
formats.description: Private chatroom with 24/7 support and Q&A.

formats.label: Trade logs & recordings
formats.description: Daily trade logs, performance reports and stream recordings to review.

broker_partnership.description: Trade Momentum is a paid marketing partner of TradeZero — TradeZero's own site states Trade Momentum "may receive compensation for introducing customers to TradeZero." Members get a 2% deposit bonus, 90 days of free ZeroPro platform access, and a 5% discount on locates for 90 days, using the promo code TRADEMOMENTUM at sign-up.

pricing.name: 60-Day Trading Bootcamp
pricing.billing_note: One-time payment; payment plans available. Includes full mentorship and lifetime access to the bootcamp's class library.

course.refund_policy: No refund or money-back guarantee is stated on the provider's website (last checked 2026-10-03).
